tools.name: fetch_feed
tools.description: Fetch an RSS or Atom feed and return clean JSON: feed title/link plus up to 50 entries with title, link, published date and summary. Works with any feed URL.

tools.name: fetch_article
tools.description: Extract the main article text and Markdown from a web page URL: title, author, date, site name, plain text (up to 20k chars) and Markdown (up to 40k chars).
